page.overview:
Who is Aoba Hashibira?

Aoba shares a striking resemblance with his ancestor, having feminine features that cause people to mistake him for a woman. He has black, shoulder length hair with overlapping bangs and emerald green eyes. However, unlike Inosuke, Aoba has a physically smaller build and jet black hair rather than hair that fades from black to blue like Inosuke's, the same as Aoi.

As a researcher, he wears a standard uniform consisting of a white button up shirt and lab coat, as well as blue slacks and black shoes.

Unlike either of his ancestors, Inosuke and Aoi, Aoba was soft-spoken and timid. Being the leading researcher in charge of study the Blue Spider Lily, he held a press conference to apologize to the public for a mistake in their research and took it upon himself to shoulder the blame, showing that he was earnest and sincere.

Despite their stark contrast in character, Aoba has shown one similarity to Inosuke. Following the mistake in his study, he had voiced his wish to "live alone deep in the mountains", following the backlash he endured.
